title: On the construction of geographical maps: Lagrange, Chebyshev, Darboux and Milnor
summary: Lagrange, Chebyshev, and Darboux, in 1779, 1856, and 1911, respectively, wrote articles all bearing the same title, \emph{On the Construction of Geographical Maps}. In 1969, Milnor wrote a paper in which he refers to Chebyshev's paper, of which he provides a new formulation and proof. In the present article, we review the results of all these papers, explaining the main ideas they contain and pointing out connections between them.
